correctness.rationale: A normalized Ewens cycle tilt differentiates to the desired covariance. Ewens insertion yields a rigorous rational recurrence for each original-permutation record event, with the exact singleton-cycle base; at theta=1 the coefficient derivatives cancel, and the product telescopes to the stated binomial reciprocal. Summation and a transparent binomial lower bound prove the asymptotics. The included independent verifier completed 1,720 exact assertions including exhaustive n≤9 computations and Ewens nonuniform checks. Finite tests are corroboration, not proof of all sizes.

No inspected broader theorem gives the required identity. Classical multivariate permutation generating functions could remain an unresolved historic source.

value.rationale: The cycle count and left-to-right record count are natural fundamental permutation statistics, famously equidistributed but not identical on the same sample. Their exact finite cross-dependence was not supplied by the inspected marginal theory. The theorem determines every positionwise mixed covariance, strict global sign and the sharp leading correlation scale, with the unexpected structural fact that a terminal fixed point dominates the whole dependence. No downstream theorem is asserted as necessary for this structural value.
